title: Feed Formulation Calculator
description: Arabic RTL application replacing spreadsheet-based feed formulation with instant nutritional calculations, cost analysis, saved recipes, protected admin controls, Excel/PDF export, and full offline support.
problem: How can a spreadsheet-based formulation task become easier to use and repeat?
approach: Built an Arabic RTL React PWA with nutritional calculations, cost analysis, saved recipes and spreadsheet/PDF export.
outcome: A live application and source repository demonstrate how a calculation workflow can become an accessible tool.
limitations: Calculations depend on the supplied ingredient data. Formulations require review by a qualified domain professional before practical use.
